timing.signal: intraday on the bar whose high reaches the trigger (stop order resting from the prior close)
timing.earliestExecutable: same bar: fill = max(open, trigger); every level uses only bars up to the prior close
timing.decisionData: prior-close N, prior-close channels, prior-close strength rank

entryConditions: TUR-SF-ENTRY (20-day + 1 tick) unless TUR-SF-S1-FILTER skips it; then TUR-SF-FAILSAFE (55-day)
stops: TUR-SF-STOP 2N per unit from its own fill
TUR-SF-STOPADD +1/2 N for every earlier unit per add

corporateActionPolicy.corporateActions: snapshot convention hash (adjustSeries, splitSegments, MAX_GAP_DAYS); no new corporate-action protocol
corporateActionPolicy.rule: split-adjusted OHLC from the snapshot; raw prices only where a rule names a raw quantity (tick, price floor); no price reconstruction for missing bars

contracts.missingDataBehavior: A missing or non-executable bar produces no decision and no fill (validation/accounting-contract.mjs isExecutableBar); indicators that need an absent bar return null and the rule is not evaluated; nothing is interpolated.
knownLimitations: equity adaptation, long only: net long beta, not the futures risk profile
correlation limits (6 / 10 units) not applied: no point-in-time groups (TUR-SF-LIMIT-CORR, DATA_BLOCKED)
cash account: with 1 % / N units only a few units fit in cash; REJECT_NO_CASH is counted
daily bars: the order of intrabar events is a convention (exits before adds; a raised stop is re-checked pessimistically on an add bar)
failsafe exit not stated in the source (TUR-SF-FAILSAFE-EXIT, SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS)

contracts.method: Later Q&A box construction, buy-stop entry and box stop method (machine component) with manual techno-fundamental layer

layers.MECHANICAL: box state machine, buy stop, initial and raised stops (DAR-Q1..Q9)
layers.MANUAL: techno-fundamental selection, volume judgment, market context, sizing, re-entry

timing.signal: buy stop resting a fraction above a COMPLETED box top (both boundaries confirmed by the close of the confirming session)
timing.earliestExecutable: the first session after the box is complete whose high reaches the trigger; fill = max(open, trigger)
timing.decisionData: box boundaries known at the prior close

entryConditions: DAR-SF-ENTRY on a box from DAR-SF-TOP + DAR-SF-BOTTOM; DAR-SF-ATH gate
exitConditions: stop only (DAR-SF-STOP-INIT, DAR-SF-STOP-RAISE); no profit target (DAR-B7)
stops: DAR-SF-STOP-INIT a fraction below the broken top
DAR-SF-STOP-RAISE a fraction below the bottom of each new completed higher box, never lowered

corporateActionPolicy.corporateActions: snapshot convention hash (adjustSeries, splitSegments, MAX_GAP_DAYS); no new corporate-action protocol
corporateActionPolicy.rule: split-adjusted OHLC from the snapshot; raw prices only where a rule names a raw quantity (tick, price floor); no price reconstruction for missing bars

requiredData: price history from the listing date for the all-time high (DAR-Q9; snapshot history may start later -> flagged)
contracts.missingDataBehavior: A missing or non-executable bar produces no decision and no fill (validation/accounting-contract.mjs isExecutableBar); indicators that need an absent bar return null and the rule is not evaluated; nothing is interpolated.

manualReviewFlags.question: techno-fundamental selection: industry growth expectation, strongest stock of the industry, expected earning power
volume relative to the stock's own history (no general minimum)
market trend and relevant industry representatives
position size, pilot buys and adds are the reviewer's decision; personal exceptions (DAR-C1, DAR-C3, DAR-C6) are not generalized
"a fraction": the machine uses one raw cent; the reviewer may set another fraction per trade (DAR-C-THIO)

knownLimitations: the full Darvas method (selection, volume, market, sizing) cannot be measured on history: manual decisions are logged forward only
all-time high is evaluated within the snapshot history; when that history does not reach the listing date the flag is ALL_TIME_HIGH_IN_AVAILABLE_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED
start of the bottom search is UNRESOLVED in #709 (VU-DAR); both readings are supported, the default is declared

contracts.method: Stage 2 Investor: early Stage 2 breakout above resistance, half position at the breakout, half on a constructive pullback

layers.MECHANICAL: weekly bars, MA30w gate, base / resistance level, volume alternatives, RS evidence
layers.MANUAL: stage, overhead resistance, support stop, sizing, pullback add, trailing

timing.signal: the completed week whose high exceeds the base resistance (buy-stop prepared from the prior week)
timing.earliestExecutable: a reviewer decision after the week closes; never back-filled into history
timing.decisionData: weekly bars up to the signal week, SPY weekly for RS and market evidence

stops: WEIN-SF-INV-STOP (proposal below the base low, reviewer decides)
positionSizing: WEIN-SF-INV-SIZE (manual: half at the breakout, half on the pullback; roughly equal dollar amounts)

corporateActionPolicy.corporateActions: snapshot convention hash (adjustSeries, splitSegments, MAX_GAP_DAYS); no new corporate-action protocol
corporateActionPolicy.rule: split-adjusted OHLC from the snapshot; raw prices only where a rule names a raw quantity (tick, price floor); no price reconstruction for missing bars

requiredData: daily split-adjusted OHLCV aggregated to weeks
contracts.missingDataBehavior: A missing or non-executable bar produces no decision and no fill (validation/accounting-contract.mjs isExecutableBar); indicators that need an absent bar return null and the rule is not evaluated; nothing is interpolated.

manualReviewFlags.question: is this an early Stage 2 breakout out of a Stage 1 base?
is the volume confirmation clear (alternatives A / B / C reported)?
is RS negative and still poor (no buy), or below zero but clearly improving?
strong overhead resistance nearby?
industry group stage (no data in the machine)
which correction low is significant for the initial stop?

knownLimitations: industry group and market breadth rules are DATA_BLOCKED; the method cannot be fully automated or measured on history
base start = the week the 30-week MA stopped falling (observable turn); a VU reading of "MA30 flattens after a decline", declared
